files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added
- Dependencies between tasks of the same project (subtasks of one main task, or main tasks of one list) in four kinds: finish → start, start → start, finish → finish, start → finish. They are stored in the predecessor as RELATED-TO with RELTYPE (RFC 9253), so other apps that know the standard read them too; apps that do not may show such a link like a main task
  - Timeline: drag from the dot at an end of a bar to another bar (a note says which kind, or why not). Arrows show the dependencies, red when the dates do not fit; click an arrow to change the kind or remove it. Moving a bar moves dependent tasks along as far as needed (with a note). The arrows can be hidden in the timeline options
  - Sidebar: "Dependencies" with "Waits for" and "Then", each with its kind and what it means. Added there, nothing moves; dates that do not fit are marked red
  - List, table and board: a chain icon on tasks that wait for open predecessors, red when the dates do not fit (the status does not change)
- Titles are changed where they are shown: a click on the name in the list or the table edits it right there, with the caret where you clicked (the rest of the row opens the task). F2 and "Rename" in the menu of a task do the same. Enter saves, Esc cancels
- The sidebar shows the whole title over several lines; a click edits it in place, with the caret where you clicked
- Settings: "Lists in the navigation" with a switch for each list

### Changed
- The timeline shows the bell only for real follow-ups (tasks with the waiting tag); a task that waits for its start date has its bar there already
- A duplicated task does not take the dependencies along; tasks created from a template keep the dependencies between each other
- Translations from Nextcloud Tasks

### Fixed
- The filters of the overview (lists, people, tags) only offered the first two entries
